rule: a data key in a log, under the name the code uses
why: THE SAME LEAK UNDER THE NAME THE CODE USES. `52 §6`'s example is `console.log(plaintext)` and no file here has ever held a variable called that; the key hierarchy calls its secrets `plain`, `dek`, `kek`, `root` and `pkcs8`. One fixture per vocabulary, so widening the pattern is a thing that can be proved rather than asserted.
